en.headline: Police arrest driver after Mercedes hits three vehicles while fleeing in Kwun Tong
en.dek: A Pakistani man was detained on Thursday evening after a rented Mercedes struck several cars in Kwun Tong; officers found etomidate, methamphetamine and cocaine inside the vehicle.
body: Police arrested a man on suspicion of dangerous driving and trafficking in dangerous drugs after a Mercedes-Benz private car hit multiple vehicles while attempting to flee in Kwun Tong on Thursday evening.

Officers received reports around 7pm that a car had struck vehicles on Wan Hon Street and Shui Wo Street before continuing. A patrol that had stopped the driver for a check saw him accelerate away; the car then struck further vehicles before being intercepted at the junction of Fu Yan Street and Shung Yan Street.

Police said the driver, a Pakistani national in his late twenties who was at the wheel of a rented car, was taken into custody. Inside the vehicle officers found a bag containing suspected etomidate, methamphetamine and cocaine. No one was injured in the collisions.
The case has been handed to the Kwun Tong district crime investigation team for further enquiries into the circumstances of the chase and the drugs recovered.

zh.headline: 觀塘平治逃捕連撞三車 警拘巴基斯坦裔司機檢獲毒品
zh.dek: 周四晚上約七時，一輛租來的平治在觀塘撞及多部車輛後企圖逃走，警方在崇仁街截獲，車上檢獲依托咪酯、冰毒及可卡因。
body: 警方周四晚上在觀塘截獲一輛企圖逃走的平治私家車，拘捕車上一名巴基斯坦裔男子，涉嫌危險駕駛及販運危險藥物。
約晚上七時，警方接獲雲漢街及瑞和街有車輛被撞的報案。據了解，一輛巡邏警車當時截查該車，司機突然加速離開，其間先後撞及車房私家車、路邊貨車及另一輛私家車，之後調頭逆線繼續行駛。
警方其後在輔仁街與崇仁街交界截停涉事車輛。消息指被捕男子年約二十多歲，駕駛的是租來的平治。警員在車上搜獲一袋懷疑毒品，包括依托咪酯、冰毒及可卡因。事件中沒有人受傷。
案件已交由觀塘警區刑事調查隊跟進，繼續調查逃走經過及毒品來源。
